info.name: LlamaIndex LlamaCloud Data Sources Extraction Jobs API

items.docs: Run an extraction job by specifying an extraction agent and one or more files to process. The job runs asynchronously and can be polled for status and results.

params.name: jobId
params.description: Unique identifier of the extraction job.

items.docs: Retrieve the current status of an extraction job. Poll this endpoint to check whether the job has completed processing.

params.name: jobId
params.description: Unique identifier of the extraction job.

items.docs: Retrieve the structured data extracted from the documents processed by a completed extraction job. Results conform to the schema defined in the extraction agent.
